select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, d.ps as ps, /**交易方向**/ d.ps as psCode, d.FINPROD_ID as assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.finprod_abbr as assetAbbr, /**资产简称**/
CASE d.is_out_trade WHEN 'N' THEN fp.FINPROD_ABBR ELSE mci.customer_name END as counterId, /**交易对手**/ d.is_out_trade as isOutTrade,/* 是否外部交易 */ DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate, /**交易日**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate, /**交割日**/ d.ccy as ccy, /**币种**/ d.chl_id as pass , /**通道**/ IFNULL(d.PRIN_AMT,'0') as prinAmt, /**交易本金**/ IFNULL(d.INT_AMT,'0') as intAmt , /**应计利息**/ IFNULL(tdf.fee_amt,'0') as tdFeeAmt , /**通道费用**/ IFNULL(d.TRADE_AMT,'0') as tradeAmt, /**交易金额**/ d.INV_AIM as invAimCode, /**投资目的Code**/ d.INV_AIM as invAim, /**投资目的**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as vDate,/** 计息开始日 **/ DATE_FORMAT(d.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as mDate/** 计息截止日 **/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id left join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and zc.finprod_type = d.finprod_type inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on d.counter_id = mci.customer_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on d.counter_id = fp.finprod_id where 1=1 and d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
